items.title: Lillie Delk Christian Interview, 1961-04-25
items.q: Well, I had met him. You know, he was a... My foster sister knew him, and he came to see her, you know. And she... He was... I was introduced to him.

ctx.x: Oh, yes. It was one of the things that I wondered about. How did you happen to get to know Johnny? Did you say just he heard you singing around the house? How did I get to know him? Yeah.

Well, I had met him. You know, he was a... My foster sister knew him, and he came to see her, you know. And she... He was... I was introduced to him. And of course I was singing and singing around the house. And he says, uh... Lily, say, my goodness. You say you have an awful good voice. Why don't you do something with that voice? I said, well, why don't you help me do something with it? He said, well, I will. I'll see what I can do. Because at that time he was playing at Harman's, uh... Yeah.
The Dreamland, maybe? Yeah. The Dreamland Ballroom.
